info.name: ribbon-health Cost Estimates Focus Area Endpoints API

params.name: page
params.description: The page of the results which was returned.

params.name: page_size
params.description: How many results are in each page.

params.name: search
params.description: String input that fuzzy searches against key fields within each clinical area object to return the most relevant options.

params.name: clinical_area
params.description: String input that fuzzy searches on `display` field.

params.name: _excl_clinical_area_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of clinical area UUIDs to exclude from search results.

params.name: specialty_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of specialty UUIDs.

params.name: condition
params.description: String input that fuzzy searches on `condition.display` field.

params.name: condition_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of condition UUIDs.

params.name: treatment
params.description: String input that fuzzy searches on `treatment.display` field.

params.name: treatment_ids
params.description: Comma separated list of treatment UUIDs.

params.name: type
params.description:
String input of the type of clinical areas to return. Options for input are either `providers` or `locations`.
Note: Defaults to returning all clinical areas of any type.
